abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait
abilities.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

abilities.name: Pick up
abilities.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

abilities.name: Observe wildlife
abilities.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
abilities.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
abilities.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

abilities.name: Cautious food assessment
abilities.function: Examine an owned material or consume a measured sample and monitor actual personal effects.
abilities.costs: Examine: 2 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each. Sample: 5 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each plus 1 ingestion energy, the specified 0.1–1 resource units and real proportional harm; metabolism continues. Requires health >=80; sample satiety <=90. Reserved material ages and cannot be spent twice.
abilities.effects: Retain dated sensory and exposure evidence with confounders, never a safety certification or hidden composition. Interrupted, invalidated or fatal work releases only unconsumed surviving escrow. A completed nourishing exposure without injury or another food intake may give modest relief: 1 for 6 rounds, cooldown 12, no stacking. Owned items are located at the carrier, not their old pickup coordinates.

satisfaction.name: Nature appreciation
satisfaction.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfaction.name: Cautious food relief
satisfaction.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.

developments.reason: Reviewed against the real world-10 decision and Sol request at round 17. The package installs only an inactive public interface, empty bounded dated sightings and a registered personal experience rule; Sol must spend two study rounds, and other identities must learn separately. Actual execution needs two consecutive stationary personally visible animal samples, costs 0.5 energy per round plus metabolism, and changes no animals, geometry, stock, health or movement. It retains at most 16 dated species/position/behavior samples, cancels interruption and lost visibility without refund, and cancels even a completion event on same-round death while retaining mastery and sightings. Nature appreciation is computed from actual completed events: 3 for 12 rounds, cooldown 8; another reward within 24 rounds adds a separately expiring value 1 layer, using max rather than sum and never extending the original high award. Reward history persists across death while active sources clear. Registry rejects malformed window rules and equivalent sources. Core tests exercise paid duration, individual learning, windowed max/expiry, interruption, lost view, same-round death and cross-life memory. All 382 unit tests, types, lint, formatting, architecture and build passed. The complete archive/browser gates correctly remain incomplete while ex8 has no finalized replay; their failure logs are retained, and the complete acceptance suite will run after capture. Actual focused browser diagnostics passed all three forest scenarios; current-conversation visual inspection opened both wildlife progress/completion images and corrected the initially overlapping label. The marker is attached only to an animal currently visible to the observer; UI labels past sightings and separates important experience. The source-bound checkpoint compatibility repair permits only three exact before/after file hashes (reader, verifier call site and regression), keeps the forest configuration exact, rejects modified budgets or hunger, preserves the untouched initial source snapshot and all ten calls, and changes no policy, prompt, transport, seed, budgets or executed prefix. This is current-conversation implementation review, not independent approval.

Current-conversation technical review of the retained computation-only round-166 pause, not an actor-authored request or independent approval. The original 70 calls, pending actions, world, seed, model, two-million-work limit and all role budgets are retained. Conservative spatial buckets still use exact collision tests; a stable heap preserves insertion tie order, and the isolated original pending round now settles with two genuine no-route failures and one move rather than budget exhaustion. Deterministic rotated geometry comparisons passed. Perception fixes activate only through forest-perception@1: actual personal arrivals, observed discoveries, local conditions and externally changed visible sources emit already-declared events without choosing behavior or granting rewards. New tests distinguish pre-installation absence, grounded events and absence of repeated unchanged meetings. Continuous token renewal uses only the original OAuth grant and fixed endpoint, serializes the one experiment process, atomically saves outside archives, preserves verified identity metadata and never retries inference. Mock credential tests prove a single renewal, private atomic rotated storage and unchanged session on failed renewal; no credentials enter retained evidence. Type checking, focused five regressions and current full lint passed. The mandatory development gate will independently run all unit tests, types, architecture and build and reconstruct all 166 committed world/event hashes before acceptance. Exact protected-source pairs constrain the controller technical-barrier change, token supplier and CLI prechecks, and forest-only report whitespace repair. The original malformed generated report is retained byte-for-byte as technical-pauses/round-166/report.txt. Source history, earlier capture and current task recovery journal retain the failure; no simulation time advanced during development.

Current-conversation review of the real round-331 Sol request and world-158 specification, not independent approval. Food assessment requires three individual learning rounds and actual two-round examination or five-round sampling. Unique escrow retains provenance, age and load; exact tenths conserve mass across consumption, cancellation, transfer, spoilage and death. Shared food effects retain actual nutrition and harm. Records distinguish sensory observations, measured exposure, concurrent events and uncertainty; no hidden composition or safety certification is revealed.
